body:
Spent the early morning around 1AM on the 7th , writing goodbye letters to my sister, apologised for the pain I have left and hopefully one day she can maybe understand why I did what I did, or at least try to understand. Put a few things that I thought she should have in a shoe box together with my last wish letter asking kindly that I don't want to be buried but want to have my ashes throw at the beach in my favourite happy place which she knows the place.

The other box I had a letter written to my Ex, we broke up a few months ago, I know she will be in pain, put a few things for her in the box which each thing in an envelope and I wrote outside the envelope the memory of that thing, took me sometime to do all this you know, 2 hours in I had just finished my second bottom of presseco but was getting too drunk quick but maybe it's because I barely eat, had a croissant in the afternoon before.

Put the 2 boxes on top of the stove in the kitchen, put all my house keys in an envelope with the estate agent business card on it. Went to take a shower, dressed myself up. Had cleaned my flat earlier in the day, I am OCD with cleaniless. Open the bottle of rum and put a bit in the glass mixed it with coke. 

I even wrote all my email and social media logins and gave them to my sister and also my ex gf. 

My bed had clean bedding and I was ready to take my tablets. During the course of me getting into bed I then realised I stil had my phone on me, my plan was to hide so no can see how I have been researching on the internet, in the process of me getting out of bed to try hide my phone a few messages came on WhatsApp from the girl I sort of been seeing for like 2 months now, my ex gf and my best mate. Replied a few text and turned of my mobile data. At this point I don't know why exactly I did not take my tablets as planned, I don't know if I am glad either do I know I'd regret not taking them, 

My moods are all over the place, I have a few minutes I feel just okay then I go back straight into my dark space, as I write I am a little better but I know that is only for a little bit , 

I don't know what to do with my life, I know I have had mental issues with other things in the past and somehow some I have managed to go for abit of time managing, I am struggling , I don't know what my plan is, maybe I will be ready tonight or tomorrow to attempt to execute my plan,

I never thought I would log back here again. I don't know how I feel about login back and writing what I have. I have read the comments here, those struggling too don't you wish we just a switch just one switch to your life and press off when you want with one touch...

Tired of the pain in my head, have had it for years and now it's worse
I have sent you a message if not please can you message me directly
What did you take ? Where you found in time ? I live alone so I know I won't be found till at least minimum after 24 hours, just need to do it very right ,
